column1: 21074§proliferate§prəˈlɪfəreɪt§v. 激增，迅速繁殖（或增殖）§If these other quick-growing species of bushes and plants are allowed to proliferate, they harm the eucalyptus in another way, by affecting the composition of the soil, and removing nutrients from it.§如果这些其他快速生长的灌木和植物得以激增，它们会以另一种方式损害桉树，影响土壤的成分，并从土壤中迁移养分。
21075§surgery§ˈsɜːdʒəri§n. 外科学；外科手术；手术室，诊疗室§They perform surgery between 9:00 and 11:30 every weekday.§他们在每个工作日的9:00到11:30做手术。
21076§catastrophe§kəˈtæstrəfi§n. 大灾难§The flood was a major catastrophe, reducing population sizes in areas involved.§洪水是一场大灾难，使受灾地区的人口减少。
21077§overwork§ˌəʊvəˈwɜːk§v. （使）过度劳累；对…使用过度；滥用（词等） n. 过重的工作；工作过度§He has been overworking for two months, at last he fell ill in the workplace.§他已经连续劳累工作两个月之久，最后病倒在了工作岗位上。
21078§parental§pəˈrentl§adj. 父的；母的；父母（般）的§The government repeatedly stressed its support for parental choice in the selection of a child's school.§政府一再重申其支持家长对孩子教育的选择权。
21079§various§ˈveəriəs§adj. 各种各样的；不同的；多方面的§The professor has studied the languages of various countries.§这位教授研究过多个国家的语言。
21080§sediment§ˈsedɪmənt§n. 沉淀物；沉积物（如沙、砾、石、泥等）§There was heavy brown sediment in the bottom of the bottle.§水壶的底部有厚厚的棕色沉淀物。
21081§resit§ˈriːsɪt§v./n. 重修，补考§The four students resat the final examinations and passed this time.§这四名学生参加了期末考试补考，这次都通过了。
21082§menace§ˈmenəs§n. 威胁；危险的人（或物） vt. 威胁到，危及§Let's look at some of the reasons why back pain is developing into such a unique menace.§让我们来看一看为什么背疼会演变成一种顽疾。
21083§contain§kənˈteɪn§vt. 包含，容纳，装有；控制，阻止，遏制§It is traditionally accepted that children's books should contain a few pictures.§从传统意义上来说，人们普遍认为儿童读物中应该配有一些插图。
21084§fasten§ˈfɑːsn§v. 扎牢，扣住§The driver must fasten his seat belt before driving.§司机在开车前必须系好安全带。
21085§establish§ɪˈstæblɪʃ§vt. 建立；确立；安置，使定居§You may have to establish new eating habits in order to keep healthy.§为了保持健康，你需要养成一些新的饮食习惯。
21086§position§pəˈzɪʃn§n. 位置，方位；职位，职务；姿势，姿态；见解，立场 vt. 安放，安置§The position of women in society has changed markedly in the last twenty years.§在过去的20年间，妇女的社会地位有了显著的改变。
21087§simulate§ˈsɪmjuleɪt§vt. 模仿，模拟；假装，伪装；扮演§The experiment simulated a natural environment.§这个试验模拟了一种自然环境。
21088§scratch§skrætʃ§n. 划伤，抓痕 v. 抓，搔；划破，划损§There is a small scratch on my bag.§我的包上有一道不长的划痕。
21089§flexitime§ˈfleksitaɪm§n. 弹性工作制§Flexitime is one good method to reduce the number of vehicles traveling together at rush hour.§采用弹性工作制是降低交通高峰期车流量的好方法。
21090§assist§əˈsɪst§v. 帮助，援助，协助§The Student Union is intended to assist in teachers' work.§学生会旨在协助老师的工作。
21091§illegal§ɪˈliːɡl§adj. 不合法的，违法的§The police arrested the old lady for illegal possession of drugs.§警方以非法持有毒品为由逮捕了这位老妇人。
21092§ultimately§ˈʌltɪmətli§adv. 最终地§The paper was written, edited, typeset and ultimately printed.§报纸经过编写、编辑、排版，最后被印刷出来。
21093§sinew§ˈsɪnjuː§n. 肌腱；力量的来源§The athletes were so nervous that we could see all their sinews tense.§运动员非常紧张，以致我们能看到他们紧绷的肌肉。
21094§artificial§ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃl§adj. 人工的，人造的；假的，矫揉造作的；模拟的§We use no artificial additives of any kind in our products.§我们的产品绝不含任何人工添加剂。
21095§veil§veɪl§n. 面纱；遮蔽物 vt. 蒙着面纱；掩饰§They lifted the veil of this ancient tomb.§他们揭开了这座古代陵墓的神秘面纱。
21096§tend§tend§v. 倾向于，趋于；照料；招待§Women tend to research thoroughly before applying for positions or attending interviews.§在申请职位或是参加面试前，女性往往会（对应聘公司及职位）进行全面彻底的了解。
21097§removal§rɪˈmuːvl§n. 除去；免职；搬迁§I saw a removal van outside your house yesterday afternoon.§昨天下午我看见你家屋外停着一辆搬家卡车。
21098§parallel§ˈpærəlel§n. 可相比拟的事物（或人），相似处；纬线 adj. 平行的；类似的，相对应的；并行的 vt. 与…相似；比得上§The expressway is parallel to the railway.§这条高速公路与铁路平行。
21099§compel§kəmˈpel§vt. 强迫§The boss compels workers to spend more time on the job.§老板强迫工人花更多的时间在工作上。
21100§immediately§ɪˈmiːdiətli§adv. 立即，马上；紧接地；直接地§You go down to the end of this corridor and turn right. The computer lab is immediately on your right.§走到走廊尽头向右拐，右手边就是机房。
21101§institute§ˈɪnstɪtjuːt§n. 研究所，学院 vt. 建立，设立§The Language Institute provides student support, welfare and activities services.§语言学院为学生提供资助、福利和活动服务。
21102§serial§ˈsɪəriəl§n. 连续剧 adj. 连续的；顺序排列的§A lot of people complained that American police serials were particularly violent.§许多人抱怨美国的警匪片太暴力了。
21103§oversee§ˌəʊvəˈsiː§vt. 监督，监视§You must appoint someone to oversee the project.§你得指派某个人监督这个项目。
21104§reinforce§ˌriːɪnˈfɔːs§vt. 加强；增援§Concrete with steel bars in it is known as reinforced concrete.§水泥中加入钢条就成了我们所知的钢筋混凝土。
21105§commitment§kəˈmɪtmənt§n. 委托；承诺，许诺；奉献，投入§This commitment has been clearly defined in the act.§这项法案中明确定义了这一义务的内容。
21106§donation§dəʊˈneɪʃn§n. 捐款；捐赠§The work of the charity is funded by voluntary donations.§这家慈善机构工作所需资金是人们自愿捐赠的。
21107§curious§ˈkjʊəriəs§adj. 好奇的；奇怪的§Further observation by astronomers revealed two curious facts.§天文学家经过进一步观察发现了两个奇怪的现象。
21108§overdraft§ˈəʊvədrɑːft§n. 透支；透支额§Some workers have a huge overdraft to pay off every month.§一些工人每个月都要偿还巨额透支款。
21109§optical§ˈɒptɪkl§adj. 视力的；光学的§We'll discuss optical fibres and how they could be used in the future to improve optical instruments.§我们将讨论光纤以及将来如何把它们用于改善光学仪器等问题。

21110§otherwise§ˈʌðəwaɪz§adv. 否则，不然；用别的方法；在其他方面§It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will cost you ￡5, otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every half and an hour from the station.§从车站打车（到这）要十分钟，车费是五英镑。另外，你还可以乘从车站出发的公共汽车，一个半小时一班。
21111§possession§pəˈzeʃn§n. 持有，拥有；所有权；所有物，财产，财富；领土§It would be a good idea to get some insurance for the furniture and other personal possessions.§给家具和其他一些个人财产上保险是一个不错的主意。
21112§however§haʊˈevə(r)§conj. 不管用什么方法adv. 无论如何，不管怎样；然而；不过；仍然§I feel a bit sleepy, however, I keep studying.§我有点困了，但我仍坚持学习。
21113§retail§ˈriːteɪl§n. 零售 v. 零售，以…价格销售§What sorts of shop do you like best, the department store or the small retails ?§你最喜欢哪种商店，百货商场还是小零售店？
21114§cultural§ˈkʌltʃərəl§adj. 文化的，人文的§The exhibition showed some cultural relics of the primeval times.§该展览展出了很多原始时期的文化遗产。
21115§solution§səˈluːʃn§n. 解答，解决办法；溶解，溶液§It took time to find solution to the problem.§找到解决该问题的方法需要时间。
21116§morality§məˈræləti§n. 道德，美德§Mankind has undergone great improvement in intelligence or morality.§人类无论在智力方面还是在道德方面都经历了巨大的进步。
21117§transaction§trænˈzækʃn§n. 办理；处理；交易，业务；[pl.] 会报，学报§The teller told me that the computer system was temporarily down, so they couldn't do any transactions.§出纳员告诉我计算机系统临时出故障了，所以他们不能进行任何交易。
21118§twofold§ˈtuːfəʊld§adj. 两倍的，双重的；有两部分的 adv. 两倍地，双重地§There has been a twofold increase in the number of rare birds in the past decade.§在过去的十年，珍稀鸟类的数量增加了两倍。
21119§embassy§ˈembəsi§n. 大使馆；大使馆全体官员§Your visa application is being processed at the UK Embassy.§你的签证正由英国大使馆办理。
21120§remark§rɪˈmɑːk§v. 评论，谈论；注意到，察觉 n. 评语，评论；注释§Can you remark the differences between the two paintings?§你能说出这两幅画的不同之处吗？
21121§delay§dɪˈleɪ§n./v. 耽搁，延迟，延期§After a delay of two days, the whole team continued the journey.§耽搁了两天后，整个小组继续行进。
21122§congress§ˈkɒŋgres§n. （代表）大会；（美国等国的）国会，议会§The congress called on the local governments to reopen schools after the war.§战后，国会号召地方政府重开学校。
21123§germ§dʒɜːm§n. 微生物，细菌；起源，萌芽§The patient had not the strength to throw off the germs that had invaded his immune system.§病人无力摆脱已经侵入其免疫系统的病菌。

21124§fashion§ˈfæʃn§n. 方式；流行款式；时装§You'll find all sorts of things in the museum: old suitcases, ships'crockery, and classical cabins decorated in the fashion of the day.§在博物馆里你会找到各类东西：陈旧的手提箱、陶制船模型，还有以当时风格装饰的古典小屋。
21125§splash§splæʃ§v. 溅；泼§I refreshed myself by splashing cold water on my face.§我往脸上扑冷水让自己精神起来。
21126§beforehand§bɪˈfɔːhænd§adv. 预先，事先§The experiment will last for one year. Beforehand, several months are devoted to planning.§试验将持续一年的时间。在此之前，要用几个月的时间制订计划。
21127§filter§ˈfɪltə(r)§n. 过滤器 v. 过滤；（消息等）走漏§Workers find that machines work much better if they change the filters regularly.§工人们发现如果他们定期更换机器里的过滤器，机器就会运转得更好。

21128§aspect§ˈæspekt§n. 方面；（建筑物的）朝向，方向；外表，外观§A great deal of empirical evidence shows that pictures in a book interfere in a damaging way with all aspects of learning to read.§大量经验表明，书中的插图给学习阅读的各方面都造成了不利影响。
21129§objection§əbˈdʒekʃn§n. 反对；反对的理由§If no one has any objection against the decision, I'll declare the meeting is closed.§如果没人反对这个决议，那么我将宣布会议结束。
21130§tunnel§ˈtʌnl§n. 隧道；地道 v. 挖地道，开隧道§The prisoner had escaped by tunnelling.§犯人挖地道逃跑了。
21131§contrast§ˈkɒntrɑːst§n. 对比；对照[kənˈtrɑːst] v. 对比；对照；形成对比§This white peak contrasts finely with the blue sky.§这座雪白的山峰同蔚蓝的天空交相辉映。

21132§effect§ɪˈfekt§n. 作用，影响；结果；效果 vt. 使产生，招致；实现§The report suggests that the smoke experienced by many people in their daily lives is enough to produce substantial adverse effects on a person's heart and lungs.§报告指出，许多人在日常生活中吸入的（香烟）烟雾足以给他们的心脏和肺造成严重的负面影响。
21133§distance§ˈdɪstəns§n. 距离；远方；一长段时间§Underground water can flow very large distances and can be kept in underground reservoirs for a very long time.§地下水可以流经很长的距离，并能在地下含水层中储藏相当长时间。
21134§stem§stem§n. 茎；（树）干；词干 vt. 止住，抑止，堵住，阻止§As the axe cut through the stem, the tree fell.§斧子砍断树干时，树倒了下来。
21135§normal§ˈnɔːml§adj. 正常的，平常的；标准的，规范的，正规的§The normal noise threshold for private housing is 55 decibels.§私人住宅区标准的噪音音量上限为55分贝。
21136§sincere§sɪnˈsɪə(r)§adj. 真挚的，真诚的，诚恳的§My respect to you is very sincere.§我对您的尊敬是非常诚挚的。
21137§summarise§ˈsʌməraɪz§v. 总结，概括§The speaker summarised the important points of her lecture.§演讲者概括了她演讲中的重点。

21138§foetus§ˈfiːtəs§n. 胎儿；胚胎§Every brain is initially female in its organisation and it only becomes a male brain when the male foetus begins to secrete hormones.§每一个大脑在结构上最初都是雌性的，只有当雄性胚胎开始分泌荷尔蒙时才变成雄性。
21139§merge§mɜːdʒ§v. （使）结合§Fact and fiction merge together in his latest thriller.§在他最新的惊险小说中，真实和虚构相互交织。
21140§aware§əˈweə(r)§adj. 知道的；意识到的§Most ecologists were aware that the areas of Amazonia they were working in had been shaped by human settlement.§大多数生态学家意识到他们研究的亚马孙地区已经受到人类居住的影响。
21141§label§ˈleɪbl§vt. 贴标签于 n. 标签，标记；称号；绰号，外号§I think we should label the lid itself and say that it constitutes twenty-five percent of the total weight.§我认为我们应该在盖子上贴上标签，注明盖子本身占总重的25%。
21142§guarantee§ˌgærənˈtiː§v. 保证；允诺 n. 保证；担保物§The box is made of stainless steel which is guaranteed for 20 years.§这个盒子是不锈钢的，品质保证期限为20年。
21143§interrelationship§ˌɪntərɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp§n. 相互关联，相互影响§This study examined the interrelationship between environment and human behaviour.§这项研究考察了环境和人类行为的相互影响。
21144§stationery§ˈsteɪʃənri§n. 文具§They manage the Student Union paper shop, selling magazines and newspapers as well as stationery and sweets.§他们负责管理学生会的报刊亭，销售杂志、报纸，还有文具和糖果。
21145§limestone§ˈlaɪmstəʊn§n. 石灰石，石灰岩§The limestone has to be dug out of the mine and transported to the power station.§石灰石必须从矿山挖出，然后被运往发电站。
